answer: A mooring bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity claims a berth, locks 70 credits in the vault, pays an onyx-sealed fee that burns. The oasis registry is open; auditors match each onyx seal to its key, and a second berth under one key burns both bonds. First berth 30, the 1,000th 6,024; 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented berths fail: one body cannot moor two. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep 70 in the vault.
